notes.title: Update 1.09: MODES have arrived!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

[h3]Build 1.09 is here, and it brings a big change - MODES have arrived![/h3]

[b]CLASSIC[/b]
Play solo or with a friend through a 10-stage match. Choose between Easy or Hard difficulty.

[b]RANDOM[/b]
Like CLASSIC, but with a twist: stage order, platform scores, and plane start positions are randomized. Starts on Easy, but ramps up to Hard during your run. Expect the unexpected!

[b]5-LIVES[/b]
Just 5 lives - how far can you go? This is a single-player challenge that starts on Easy and keeps escalating without limit. It’s tough, it’s wild, and it’s all about endurance. Good luck!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45152862/9cef14415790e62360d1d8e8cf74fcf06de1461b.png[/img]


[b]Other Additions & Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*] New offline and online leaderboards for RANDOM and 5-LIVES modes
[*] Naughty 1000pt [b]GOTCHA[/b] bonus for knocking opponents into hazards - thanks to WYP for the awesome idea!
[*] Various minor tweaks and bug fixes
[/list]

[h3]Local Scoreboards Reset[/h3]
With the introduction of these new modes, the way scores are stored had to be restructured. As a result, your local scoreboards will be reset in this update.

[b]Online leaderboards are unaffected. [/b]Your online scores and rankings remain safe.


Thanks for playing Looney Landers! I hope you enjoy the new modes and rise to the challenge.
And stay tuned - a new high score challenge is just around the corner!

Happy gaming!
